summary: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. and its operating partnership filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing that wholly owned finance subsidiary Digital Euro Finco, LLC commenced a Regulation S offering of Euro-denominated guaranteed senior unsecured notes. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Digital Realty Trust, Inc. and the operating partnership, with final terms set at pricing. Net proceeds are intended to finance or refinance renewable energy and related projects. No price, size, coupon, or maturity was disclosed. The filing is a routine debt capital markets notice, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle focuses on pricing spreads and use-of-proceeds allocation.
